title: Transcriptional patterns of amygdala functional connectivity in first-episode, drug-naïve major depressive disorder
summary: Machine-learning analysis identifies reduced amygdala connectivity in first-episode depression patients. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
organization: Institute of Mental Health, Tianjin Anding Hospital, Mental Health Center of Tianjin Medical University, Tianjin, 300222, China

evidence.tested: Machine-learning analysis identifies reduced amygdala connectivity in first-episode depression patients. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
evidence.unknown: The study does not establish improved patient outcomes or generalization beyond the evaluated setting.
